summary: Assemble TORAX power-law convection and selected boundary flux conventions

identity.direction: Explicit cell/face data to spatial operator or state update
identity.definition: Face Peclet p=distance*v/D with half-cell distance at boundaries, |D| floored to1e-20. Alpha=.5 for |p|<=.001; [(p-1)+(1-p/10)^5]/p for .001<p<=10; [(1+p/10)^5-1]/p for -10<=p<-.001; 1-1/p above10; -1/p below-10. Internal face flux uses complementary left/right alpha weights and identical flux in adjacent cells. Ghost boundaries reconstruct ghost cell from face data; direct uses imposed face value; semi-implicit weights current cell and face data. Neumann gradients are positive-coordinate at both ends.
identity.geometry: Explicit one-dimensional face grid, cell centers at arithmetic midpoints
identity.coordinates: Caller coordinate X; positive increasing direction
identity.boundary: One scalar Dirichlet value or positive-coordinate Neumann gradient at each end; homogeneous unit cross-section unless metrics supplied
assumptions: Finite converted-binary64 input quantities; caller supplies consistent units and normalization

inputs.name: v_face
inputs.description: Face convection coefficient positive toward increasing x
inputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

inputs.name: d_face
inputs.description: Signed diffusion scale used only for power-law face weighting
inputs.constraints: Finite matching faces; magnitude floor 1e-20 in supplied units, zero sign positive as TORAX

inputs.name: var
inputs.description: CellVariable provides grid and scalar boundary constraints; assembly uses its shape and boundary data

inputs.name: neumann_mode
inputs.description: Boundary face reconstruction strategy for prescribed du/dx

outputs.name: matrix
outputs.description: TriDiagonal with diagonal/above/below, to_dense() and matvec()

outputs.name: forcing
outputs.description: Boundary contribution independent of cell values

preconditions: Declared shapes, domains and matching scientific conventions; no implicit broadcasting
supported: Assemble TORAX power-law convection and selected boundary flux conventions
excluded: The absolute D floor is source behavior in supplied units, not a unit-invariant physical regularization.
Conservation is relative to selected numerical boundary flux; ghost/semi-implicit face value may differ from the prescribed Dirichlet value. No unrestricted-grid accuracy or positivity claim.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for shape/domain/finite/masked input failures; FVM nonnumeric inputs raise TypeError. No partial result.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iteration; theta is one linear solve. No convergence flag is fabricated.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial output returned on failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel finite-volume relation derived from Google DeepMind TORAX, with SciRel boundary and finite-value checks documented by the current implementation and tests. License basis: licenses/torax/LICENSE and licenses/torax/NOTICE.
provenance.license_status: Apache License 2.0 attribution and notice obligations are retained in licenses/torax/LICENSE and licenses/torax/NOTICE; scientific and release approval remain pending.

example.description: Assemble convection terms for a constant face velocity and verify the supplied constant state has zero residual.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fvm import CellVariable,make_convection_terms
v=CellVariable([1.,1.],[0.,1.,2.])
m,b=make_convection_terms([2.,2.,2.],[0.,0.,0.],v)
np.testing.assert_allclose(m.matvec(v.value)+b,0.)
example.expected: The tridiagonal operator and forcing cancel for the constant state, giving a zero residual vector.

scope: Independent flux conservation, exact linear/constant states, uniform manufactured diffusion convergence and theta causality checks
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named discrete invariants and manufactured uniform-grid convergence; no arbitrary-grid stability/accuracy or full transport-simulation claim.
known_limitations: The absolute D floor is source behavior in supplied units, not a unit-invariant physical regularization.
Conservation is relative to selected numerical boundary flux; ghost/semi-implicit face value may differ from the prescribed Dirichlet value. No unrestricted-grid accuracy or positivity claim.
